projectDescription: A computed design system framework that calculates accessible token values—color, type, spacing, density, and motion—from a small set of brand intent parameters, with APCA-driven contrast and multi-mode support built in.
keyFeatures: Computed token values — no hand-authored color ramps, type scales, or state values
APCA contrast solver for always-accessible foreground/background relationships
OKLCH color model with multi-stop intent interpolation across light/dark/dimmed
Automatic light, dark, dimmed, and high-contrast mode generation
CVD (color vision deficiency) presets including protanopia
Density system that adjusts spacing and sizing from a single space-unit
Multi-brand architecture via declarative brand config files
Platform-agnostic output for Web (CSS), iOS (Swift), and Android (Kotlin)
publicApiSurface: Brand config file (color, space-unit, type-size-unit, motion-unit, scale-ratio)
Color intent definition (hue, chroma, multi-stop range across modes)
Mode tokens: light, dark, dimmed, high-contrast, high-contrast-dark
